Market today: The market mood is mixed. While some tech names show positive underlying trends on your scanner, rising oil and diesel prices due to the Iran conflict are a real concern. This inflationary pressure can indirectly hurt tech demand and corporate margins.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.18%) and SPAL (-59.64%) are leveraged ETFs with massive losses and "SELL"/"NEW" statuses, needing immediate attention. SMH (-14.22%) is a core chip holding on "TRIM" status, also requiring a close watch. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on SMH's stop at 540 and QQQI's stop at 52. Also, watch for any further developments in oil prices and their broader economic impact.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged and underperforming positions, especially with your margin exposure.
plays: Consider trimming SMH if it breaks its 540 stop to manage your chip exposure.
Watch QQQI's 52 stop; a break suggests trimming this income anchor.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
